answer: Copying an answer hence yields nothing, and producing 45 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the prism ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the horizon review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A near-duplicate is rejected at the dune gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
